sentences.text: Aggrieved by the same petitioner is before this Court.
NC: 2026:KHC:200 HC-KAR 4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition submits that the seized articles are not at all required for the purpose of investigation of the case.
He submits that petitioner is ready and willing to furnish necessary security and abide by the conditions that may be imposed by the Court.
He also submits that if the seized articles are not released, the same is likely to get deteriorated over a period of time.
Accordingly, he prays to allow this petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP who has opposed to petition submits that investigation of the case is still under progress.

He however fairly submits that no Special Court has been constituted under the provisions of the BUDS Act at Mysore and the Special Court at Bengaluru is only the designated Court under the BUDS Act for the entire State.

6. It is not in dispute that the properties which are subject matter of P.F.No.28/2024 were seized from the custody of the petitioner and except the petitioner, nobody NC: 2026:KHC:200 HC-KAR else has filed any application in Crime No.12/2024 seeking custody of the seized properties.
The seized properties in the present case is a car and two Android mobile phones.
The above said properties have been seized from the custody of the petitioner during the case of investigation in Crime No.12/2024 in the month of March 2024.
As on this date investigation of the case is not completed and no charge sheet has been filed.
It is not in dispute that the case in Crime No.12/2024 is still pending on the file of Principal District and Sessions Judge, Mysuru and it is not transferred to any other designated Court.

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, Mysuru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. The Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of SUNDERBHAI AMBALAL DESAI VS. STATE OF GUJARAT - (2002) 10 SCC 283 has observed that Courts should be liberal while considering the application seeking the interim custody of the articles seized, if the articles are not required for the purpose of investigation and the value of the article is likely to be diminished or deteriorated.

entities.text: SUNDERBHAI AMBALAL DESAI VS. STATE OF GUJARAT - (2002) 10 SCC 283
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Petitioner has undertaken to furnish NC: 2026:KHC:200 HC-KAR necessary security and abide by the terms that may be imposed on him vide releasing the properties seized in the present case.

8. The learned District Judge has rejected the application on the ground that the said Court is not the designated Court under the provisions of the BUDS Act and also on the ground that investigation of the case is still under progress.
The properties have been seized in the present case from the custody of the petitioner in the month of March 2024.
Merely for the reason that investigation is under progress, there is no justification to retain the said properties for a indefinite period.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER (i) The Criminal revision petition is allowed.

(ii) The impugned order dated 25.06.2025 passed on the application filed by the petitioner under Section 457 of Cr.PC in Crime No.12/2024 by the Court of Principal District and Sessions Judge, Mysuru dated 25.06.2025 is set aside and consequently the prayer made in the said application filed by the petitioner under Section 457 of Cr.PC is granted.
